metadata = {"protocolName": "Serial Dilution", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    tubes = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])

    protocol.define_liquid(name="drug", description="drug stock", display_color="#FF0000")
    protocol.define_liquid(name="pbs", description="phosphate buffered saline", display_color="#0000FF")

    tubes["A1"].load_liquid(liquid="drug", volume=1000)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid="pbs", volume=1500)

    p300.pick_up_tip()
    source = tubes["A1"]

    for i in range(12):
        well = plate[f"A{i+1}"]
        p300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A1"])
        p300.dispense(100, well)
        p300.aspirate(100, source)
        p300.dispense(100, well)
        p300.mix(20, 5)
        if i < 11:
            source = well

    p300.aspirate(100, plate["A12"])
    p300.drop_tip()"}

metadata = {"protocolName": "Serial Dilution", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    tubes = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])

    drug_liquid = protocol.define_liquid(name="drug", description="drug stock", display_color="#FF0000")
    pbs_liquid = protocol.define_liquid(name="pbs", description="phosphate buffered saline", display_color="#0000FF")

    tubes["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=drug_liquid, volume=1000)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=pbs_liquid, volume=1500)

    p300.pick_up_tip()
    source = tubes["A1"]

    for i in range(12):
        well = plate[f"A{i+1}"]
        # Add PBS (diluent) first
        p300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A1"])
        p300.dispense(100, well)
        # Add drug (source) second
        p300.aspirate(100, source)
        p300.dispense(100, well)
        # Mix
        p300.mix(160, 20)
        if i < 11:
            source = well

    # Remove excess from last well
    p300.aspirate(100, plate["A12"])
    p300.drop_tip()

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    tubes = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)

    tubes["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=drug_liquid, volume=1000)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=pbs_liquid, volume=1500)

    source = tubes["A1"]

        p300.pick_up_tip()
        well = plate[f"A{i+1}"]
        # Add PBS (diluent) first
        p300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A1"])
        p300.dispense(100, well)
        # Add drug (source) second
        p300.aspirate(100, source)
        p300.dispense(100, well)
        # Mix
        p300.mix(160, 20)
        # If this is the last well, remove excess
        if i == 11:
            # Remove 100 ul from the last well to waste
            p300.aspirate(100, well)
            p300.dispense(100, reservoir["A1"])  # waste
        # Update source for next iteration (if any)
        if i < 11:
            source = well
        p300.drop_tip()

    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(100, plate["B1"])
    p300.mix(160, 20)
    p300.drop_tip()

tool_calls.name: write_protocol
tool_calls.arguments:
{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "Serial Dilution", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    tubes = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])

    drug_liquid = protocol.define_liquid(name="drug", description="drug stock", display_color="#FF0000")
    pbs_liquid = protocol.define_liquid(name="pbs", description="phosphate buffered saline", display_color="#0000FF")

    tubes["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=drug_liquid, volume=1000)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=pbs_liquid, volume=1500)

    source = tubes["A1"]

    for i in range(12):
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        well = plate[f"A{i+1}"]
        # Add PBS (diluent) first
        p300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A1"])
        p300.dispense(100, well)
        # Add drug (source) second
        p300.aspirate(100, source)
        p300.dispense(100, well)
        # Mix
        p300.mix(160, 20)
        # Remove excess from last well
        if i == 11:
            p300.aspirate(100, well)
            p300.dispense(100, reservoir["A1"])
        # Update source for next iteration
        if i < 11:
            source = well
        p300.drop_tip()

    # Add a blank well of pbs alone
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(100, plate["B1"])
    p300.mix(160, 20)
    p300.drop_tip()"}

protocol.py: 3 biology problems (1 warning, 2 notes).

1. WARNING MIX-BEFORE-DRAW: Liquid drawn from well A1 in slot 4 before it was mixed: added
at line 34, drawn at line 42
   line 34:  p300.dispense(100, reservoir["A1"])
   At line 34 liquid was added to well A1 in slot 4, which already held a different liquid.
   At line 42 liquid was drawn out of it again, and the well was never mixed in between. Two
   liquids layered in a small well do not mix on their own, so what the tip drew is not at
   the concentration you calculated. In a dilution series every later step inherits the
   error.
   Affected: well A1 in slot 4.
   Also reached 1 other well: well B1 in slot 3.
   Fix: Mix the well after the addition at line 34: `mix_after=(5, volume)` in a transfer,
   or `pipette.mix(5, volume, well)`. Integra suggests about 5 cycles at about 80% of the
   volume in the well.
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide
   Source: Svec et al. 2015: how good is a PCR efficiency estimate
           https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4822216/
   [53900f0a24d2]

2. NOTE CONTAM-STOCK: A used tip went into a stock: drug (tube A1 in slot 2)
   line 27:  p300.aspirate(100, source)
   At line 27 the tip went into drug (tube A1 in slot 2) while it still carried pbs (well A1
   in slot 4) from an earlier step. A tip that has touched one liquid leaves a little of it
   in the next liquid it touches, so this stock now holds material that does not belong
   there. The protocol does not draw from it again, so this run is not harmed, but what is
   left in the stock is no longer clean for the next run.
   Affected: tube A1 in slot 2.
   Fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 27 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand
   out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids
   afterwards with a fresh tip each.
   Source: Lab Manager: minimizing cross-contamination in automated liquid handling
           https://www.labmanager.com/minimizing-cross-contamination-in-automated-liquid-handling-workflows-35194
   Source: WHO: dos and don'ts for molecular testing
           https://www.who.int/teams/global-malaria-programme/case-management/diagnosis/nucleic-acid-amplification-based-diagnostics/dos-and-don-ts-for-molecular-testing
   [77fef177cc47]

3. NOTE NO-NEGATIVE-CONTROL: No blank on a dilution series: 13 wells of drug
   line 28:  p300.dispense(100, well)
   At line 28 the robot starts a dilution series of drug in NEST 96 Well Plate 200 µL Flat
   (slot 3): 13 wells at 13 concentrations, diluted with pbs. No well on this plate holds
   pbs with no sample, so there is no blank: the curve has no zero to read against, and a

   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 5 more in slot 3.
